title: Risk-of-bias dual assessment + adjudication
description: Independently assess risk of bias, preserve domain-level disagreements, and route unresolved judgments to senior adjudication.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: risk-of-bias-dual-arbitration
  title: Risk-of-bias dual assessment + adjudication
  description: Independently assess risk of bias, preserve domain-level disagreements, and route unresolved judgments to senior adjudication.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce instrument-correct risk-of-bias judgments with complete disagreement provenance.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 3, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [arbitration-sign-off] }
  nodes:
    - id: included-studies
      kind: input
      name: Included studies and risk-of-bias instrument
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [studies, instrument, instructions]
        properties:
          studies:
            type: array
            items: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/pdf }
          instrument: { type: string, enum: [RoB2, ROBINS-I, QUADAS-2, NOS] }
          instructions: { type: string }
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: rob-assessor-a
      kind: agent
      name: Independent risk-of-bias assessment A
      templateRef: clin-09
      role: Independent risk-of-bias assessor applying the declared instrument without seeing another assessor's judgment.
      prompt: >-
        Apply the declared risk-of-bias instrument at its required unit of analysis. Answer every applicable
        signalling question using the instrument's exact response options, cite the supporting source text,
        follow the instrument's judgment algorithm, and document any justified override. Do not convert missing
        information into a favorable judgment or force one instrument's categories onto another.
      capabilities:
        skills: [clinical-evidence-appraisal, protocol-adherence, evidence-verification]
        tools: [read, classify]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: rob-assessor-b
      kind: agent
      name: Independent risk-of-bias assessment B
      templateRef: clin-09
      role: Independent risk-of-bias assessor applying the declared instrument without seeing another assessor's judgment.
      prompt: >-
        Apply the declared risk-of-bias instrument at its required unit of analysis. Answer every applicable
        signalling question using the instrument's exact response options, cite the supporting source text,
        follow the instrument's judgment algorithm, and document any justified override. Do not convert missing
        information into a favorable judgment or force one instrument's categories onto another.
      capabilities:
        skills: [clinical-evidence-appraisal, protocol-adherence, evidence-verification]
        tools: [read, classify]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: domain-comparison
      kind: aggregator
      name: Preserve agreement and domain-level differences
      config: { aggregation: vote }
    - id: disagreement-gate
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Identify unresolved instrument-level disagreements
      role: Independent risk-of-bias disagreement evaluator
      prompt: >-
        Compare the paired assessments at the instrument's required unit of analysis. Preserve every
        signalling-question answer, judgment, citation, and rationale. Return no-disputes only when the required
        judgments agree; otherwise return has-disputes and list each disagreement without selecting a winner.
      capabilities:
        skills: [evaluation, evidence-verification]
        tools: [read, compare]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
      config: { threshold: 1.0 }
    - id: arbitrator
      kind: agent
      name: Senior risk-of-bias adjudication
      templateRef: clin-10
      role: Senior methodologist adjudicating unresolved risk-of-bias disagreements.
      prompt: >-
        Review each disputed judgment with both assessors' signalling-question answers, citations, and rationales.
        Apply the declared instrument at the correct unit of analysis, issue the best-supported final judgment,
        explain any algorithm override, and preserve both original positions in the audit trail. Mark genuinely
        insufficient evidence as unresolved instead of manufacturing consensus.
      capabilities:
        skills: [clinical-evidence-appraisal, independent-review, evidence-verification]
        tools: [read, classify]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: merge-consensus
      kind: transform
      name: Merge agreed and adjudicated judgments
      config: { operation: merge, expression: $.agreed + $.adjudicated by result,domain }
    - id: arbitration-sign-off
      kind: approval
      name: Lead methodologist approves judgments and unresolved-item log
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Consensus risk-of-bias table with provenance
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: included-studies, to: rob-assessor-a, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: included-studies, to: rob-assessor-b, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: rob-assessor-a, to: domain-comparison, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: rob-assessor-b, to: domain-comparison, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: domain-comparison, to: disagreement-gate, kind: data }
    - { id: e6, from: disagreement-gate, to: merge-consensus, kind: control, condition: no-disputes }
    - { id: e7, from: disagreement-gate, to: arbitrator, kind: control, condition: has-disputes }
    - { id: e8, from: arbitrator, to: merge-consensus, kind: data }
    - { id: e9, from: merge-consensus, to: arbitration-sign-off, kind: data }
    - { id: e10, from: arbitration-sign-off, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
